about.purpose: Cartographic placement layer. The Step 1 dataset contains NO coordinates of any kind; it names places in prose. This file is the only place where a name is given a position on the map, so that no coordinate is ever invented inside application code.
about.definition: x in [0,1] left->right, y in [0,1] top->bottom, measured against public/maps/base-atlas.png at its native 2641 x 2035 pixels. These are simulation coordinates for a fictional world. They are NOT Earth latitude/longitude and must never be presented as such.

placementGrades.MEASURED: Read directly off the supplied annotated map (public/maps/reference-annotated.png) by registering that 1920x1080 screenshot onto the 2641x2035 atlas with a SIFT + RANSAC homography (385 inliers of 414 matches) and taking the tip pixel of each marker pin. Repeatable; not authored by hand.
placementGrades.RECONSTRUCTED: Not marked on any supplied map. Positioned by relation to MEASURED anchors as described in each entry's basis field. A plausible position, not a canonical one.
placementGrades.ABSTRACT: Has no place on the map at all (a worldwide posture, a sealed space, an inter-state negotiation). Deliberately carries no coordinate; the interface renders these off-map.

about.warning: Every RECONSTRUCTED position is a rendering convenience. It is surfaced in the interface as RECONSTRUCTED and must not be read as canon.

measurementProvenance.method: SIFT keypoints, BFMatcher ratio test at 0.72, findHomography RANSAC reprojection threshold 4.0px
measurementProvenance.markerPoint: bottom tip of the teardrop pin, which is the point the pin indicates

places.name: Imperial Capital
places.basis: The Eastern Empire marker on the supplied annotated map. The corpus places the capital inside the Empire and gives no finer location.

places.name: Eastern Empire interior
places.basis: The assembly area of the invasion column before it marched. Placed just inside the Empire on the bearing from the capital towards the Great Jura Forest, so that the approach march reads as leaving the Empire westward. The corpus states only 'Eastern Empire'.

places.name: Great Jura Forest
places.basis: The forest surrounds the Tempest capital. Placed just north-east of the MEASURED Tempest marker, between Tempest and the Dwargon approach, which is the sector the campaign is fought in.

places.name: Edge of the Great Jura Forest
places.basis: Eastern margin of the forest, the point at which the imperial column stops being 'in transit'. Placed on the straight line from imperial-interior to great-jura-forest at the point where it meets the forest body. Endpoint of the Approach_Progress_Pct interpolation.

places.name: Tempest border
places.basis: The point where the imperial line of march (imperial-interior -> jura-forest-edge) crosses the Empire-Jura border drawn on the Base Map, found by tracing the march axis across the traced territory polygons (R5 cartographic check). The border line is MEASURED; the crossing point on it is RECONSTRUCTED, since the novels name no crossing place.

places.name: Dwargon Gate Front
places.basis: The decisive surface battlefield, fought at Dwargon's gate on the forest side. Placed between the MEASURED Dwargon marker and the forest, on the Dwargon-Tempest axis. Shifted south by 0.025 in the R5 cartographic check so that the battlefield lies on the forest (Jura) side of the Dwargon-Jura border traced from the Base Map, as its basis states.

places.name: Dwargon outer gate
places.basis: The fortified gate itself, between the Dwargon marker and the gate front.

places.name: Airspace over the Dwargon Gate Front
places.basis: Directly above dwargon-gate-front. Rendered as an air layer at the same ground position, since the map has no vertical dimension. Shifted south by 0.025 in the R5 cartographic check so that the battlefield lies on the forest (Jura) side of the Dwargon-Jura border traced from the Base Map, as its basis states.

places.name: Ramiris Labyrinth
places.basis: The labyrinth lies beneath the Tempest capital, so it takes the MEASURED Tempest position. It is a subsurface theatre and is rendered as such; two theatres share this ground position by design, not by error.

places.name: Dwargon eastern metropolis (Isthmus gate)
places.basis: East of the MEASURED Dwargon marker, on the isthmus facing the Empire. The corpus names an eastern gate and metropolis but locates neither.

places.name: Dwargon eastern front
places.basis: The battle line outside the eastern metropolis, one step further east than the metropolis itself.

places.name: Airspace over the Great Jura Forest
places.basis: The dragon engagement takes place over the forest. Same ground position as great-jura-forest, air layer.

places.name: Airspace over northern Ingracia
places.basis: North of the MEASURED Englassia marker, in the western half of the central continent, which is where the corpus places the Ingracia region. Low confidence: the supplied maps do not label Ingracia.

places.name: Embassy in the Empire
places.basis: Inside the imperial capital, offset so the embassy marker does not sit exactly on the capital marker.

places.name: Settlement (inter-state)
places.basis: The settlement is a negotiation between states, not a place. Deliberately given no coordinate.

places.name: Sealed space, Imperial Capital
places.basis: A severed space with no location on any map. Rendered off-map with an explicit marker.

places.name: Deployed worldwide
places.basis: A posture, not a position. Forces carrying this location are not drawn on the map.

places.name: Position unknown
places.basis: Reserved for UNKNOWN locations, including Velgrynd's space-time jump (MOV-015, AMB-009). The destination is not stated in the corpus and is not guessed.

places.name: Green Legion start line
places.basis: Tactical position inside a single battlefield. The corpus describes these only in relative terms (a start line, a chariot line, about 100 m), which is far below the scale of any supplied map. Offset from the battlefield anchor so the manoeuvre is legible. Not a located point. Shifted south by 0.025 in the R5 cartographic check so that the battlefield lies on the forest (Jura) side of the Dwargon-Jura border traced from the Base Map, as its basis states.

places.name: Central continent (via northern Ingracia)
places.basis: Destination of the Warcraft Legion air movement (MOV-014). The corpus names the central continent by way of northern Ingracia and no finer place. Positioned in the western half of the central landmass, near the MEASURED Englassia and Siltrosso markers.

places.name: Imperial main-body camp (~30 km from capital Rimuru)
places.basis: Soei reports the imperial infantry gathered about thirty kilometres from the capital Rimuru, camped and set up command posts (V13 Ch1, v13.txt:383-389). No bearing is stated. Placed 25% of the way from the MEASURED Tempest marker toward jura-forest-edge, on the imperial line of approach. The map scale is not established, so the 30 km is not measured.

places.name: Imperial camp outside the labyrinth
places.basis: Where the 170,000 who did not enter the labyrinth stayed, with Caligulio's headquarters tents, until they were annihilated on D+11 (V13 Ch3-4, v13.txt:9489-9493, 9520, 17745-17760). No location is stated beyond 'outside' the labyrinth entrance at the capital. Placed just east of the Tempest marker on the line toward jura-forest-edge.

places.name: Magitank Force main camp (Gaster's headquarters)
places.basis: Gaster's main camp lay far behind the battle line (V13 Ch2, v13.txt:5620); Testarossa kills him there (v13.txt:5763-6200). Placed east of attempted-rally-point, on the imperial side of the Dwargon gate front. The distance is not stated. Shifted south by 0.025 in the R5 cartographic check so that the battlefield lies on the forest (Jura) side of the Dwargon-Jura border traced from the Base Map, as its basis states.

places.name: Dream Fortress (isolated dimension)
places.basis: Rimuru's party, teleported by Laplace toward the Imperial Capital, lands in an isolated space in another dimension used to confine troublesome opponents (V14 Ch4 v14.txt:14549-14559, 15754-15770; V15 Ch2 v15.txt:4687-4693, 4747-4750). It has no map position.

places.name: Emperor's flagship over the Great Jura Forest
places.basis: The imperial flagship carrying Rudra hangs over the Jura theatre during the dragon battle and the flagship duels (V15 Ch1-Ch5, v15.txt:4771-4772, 11173-11177). Placed as an air layer just north-east of jura-airspace; no finer position is stated.

theatreZones.note: Schematic areas of operations, not borders. Hand-authored convex rings around the theatre anchor so that territorial control has something to shade. Marked SCHEMATIC everywhere they are drawn. The supplied maps contain no theatre boundaries.

transitAxis.note: Locations of the form 'In transit, N% of the way from the imperial interior to the forest edge' are resolved parametrically along this axis, matching Approach_Progress_Pct_SIMULATED in the Timeline sheet. The endpoints are canonical statements of origin and destination; every intermediate point is linear interpolation and is reported as RECONSTRUCTED (see AMB-014).
transitAxis.pattern: ^In transit, (\d+)% of the way from the imperial interior to the forest edge$

compoundLocationRule.note: Locations of the form 'A; later B' or 'A -> B' record a force whose station changes over the campaign. The Army Sizes sheet gives a per-frame location string, so the compound is resolved to its FIRST component for the frames before the force's recorded relocation events and is never used to invent a movement. Where the sheet itself never changes the string, the force is held at the first component and the second is carried as a note.
